classification: prospective crop-value-independent multi-state public-layer/private-prepare_layer discovery capture; exact selected-path DOD and integerization are opened, while the general public-state producer, unseen transfer, production shader changes, and Liquid Glass parity remain sealed
objective: Retain the final private prepare_layer role for every normal dense timeline CARenderer replay across eight geometry/phase regimes, join each stop to its exact public presentation-layer state without consulting crop values during selection, and expose the general public-state-to-floating-crop producer for offline derivation.

alreadyOpenedArithmetic.glassUVSpan: q times the allocated backdrop extent
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.effectiveUVOrigin: producer-pass crop-transform origin plus copy-base signed integer offset
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.glassDOD: r = max(2*blur, bleedBlur); e = 2.8*r; origin -= e; size += 2*e, followed by the observed shadow union and backdrop intersection
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.floatingToIntegerCrop: clamp origin to at least -536870911; clamp size to at most 536870912-origin; lower=floor(origin); extent=ceil(origin+size)-lower; on the opened enabled mismatch branch origin-=1 and extent+=2
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.scope: These statements are instruction-derived for the opened path and finite inputs. They do not establish the upstream floating-rectangle producer or alternate guard behavior.

captureDesign.entryGate: At the first exact prepare_layer entry, require the exact symbol start, 40,128-byte extent, complete SHA-256, all five opened code-window hashes, and the exact four bytes at +0x3ef0 before installing the marker.
captureDesign.selection: At every +0x3ef0 stop, inspect only the exact structural backtrace. Retain the stop iff there are exactly four exact prepare_layer frames and the direct transitionBackgroundUniformEvidence -> localTransitionCARendererEvidence -> carendererUniformEvidence chain is present, while matrix, fixed-state, and path-isolation callers are absent. Crop and aggregate bytes are not read until after qualification.
captureDesign.payload: For every qualified stop retain all scalar registers, 2 KiB top role, 384-byte selected source, 2 KiB stack, bounded pointer snapshots, the complete backtrace, and register plus 2 KiB role snapshots for all four prepare_layer frames.
captureDesign.join: Qualified records in callback order join one-to-one to dynamicBackgroundUniforms.records in exact array order. Each direct normal loop iteration performs exactly one CARenderer replay; missing or duplicate depth-four markers fail validation rather than being aligned by numeric crop similarity.
captureDesign.boundedness: At most 4,096 marker hits, 128 qualified records, and 64 grouped rejection classes are permitted per job. No qualified record or rejection may be silently discarded.

baselineOnly.domain: circle-640-center states on the opened selected branch
baselineOnly.definitions: P is public carrier path [1] x/y position and L=floor(P)-1
baselineOnly.status: retrospectively exact over four opened P values; not accepted prospectively and not generalized to other geometry
